description: Shared ticket 07/21 capture matrix. Paths describe shell and transport mechanics, the exact startup rewrite, and the fidelity each mechanism produces. Cells enumerate the Host/Arch/Shell matrix with the capture tier and release classification. observedRuns record only what actually ran on this machine (macOS arm64, Linux Docker arm64/amd64); Linux PowerShell, macOS x86_64, Windows, and BSD cells are documented manual acceptance steps and never claim an observation. Erroring in this file is a test failure, not product behavior.
fidelityLegend: Path fidelity: tier is the capture tier; exact means a real shell was observed reporting that field, observed means a real shell reported the field but not the value, missing means the mechanism cannot observe it, and manual/planned means this machine did not run it. A path's verification covers only the platforms named in observedPlatforms; every platform has its own cell truth. Cell fidelity: the observed object's fidelity is present only on cells with an observation run; manual.expectedFidelity is the acceptance expectation for an unrun cell and is never an observation claim. Tier 1 is the authoritative session hook, Tier 2 native OSC 133/7 without a Netcatty hook, and Tier 3 typed input plus prompt detection.

paths.name: bsd-local-zsh
paths.evidence: TestRealShellSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd (zsh on darwin/arm64, Linux arm64, and Linux amd64 Docker). The command and startup files are the same POSIX scripts on every recorded BSD; a real BSD Host is still required for the BSD cell.

paths.evidence: TestRealShellSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd (fish 4.9.3 on darwin/arm64; fish 3.6.0 on Linux Docker arm64/amd64).

paths.name: bsd-local-csh-unsupported

paths.name: bsd-remote-bash
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookKeepsTheWrapperForPOSIXLoginShells and TestRemoteWrapperInstallsEachShellAndCleansUp; a real BSD/OpenSSH Host is not available here.

paths.name: bsd-remote-tcsh-fallback

paths.name: nushell-local-hook

paths.name: nushell-local-native-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealNushellWithoutHookKeepsNativeCapture (nushell 0.116.1 on darwin/arm64): native OSC 7 gives the cwd, the prompt mark gives a finish, and the typed capture has no exit code.

paths.name: nushell-remote-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookWithdrawsForNonPOSIXLoginShells keeps the plain nushell login shell; TestRealNushellWithoutHookKeepsNativeCapture observed the local native fallback. No remote Host was available.

paths.name: xonsh-local-hook
paths.evidence: TestRealXonshSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd (xonsh 0.24.2 on darwin/arm64 and Linux Docker arm64/amd64; the harness waits for xonsh's prompt title and painted prompt before typing the next line).

paths.name: xonsh-local-native-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealXonshWithoutHookKeepsNativeFallback (xonsh 0.24.2 on darwin/arm64): OSC 7 gives the cwd; xonsh emits no OSC 133 and its prompt is not prompt-detected, so Session close leaves the exit and finish unknown.

paths.name: xonsh-remote-native-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookWithdrawsForNonPOSIXLoginShells keeps the plain xonsh login shell and TestNonPOSIXLoginShellsRejectThePOSIXWrapper reproduces the real xonsh SyntaxError. TestRealXonshWithoutHookKeepsNativeFallback observed the local OSC 7 fallback with no exit or finish: xonsh emits no OSC 133 and its prompt is not detected, and the remote transport adds no finish source. No remote Host was available.

paths.name: remote-unknown-login-shell-fallback
paths.evidence: TestSSHCaptureHookFallsBackWhenTheLoginShellIsUnknown covers an absent SFTP subsystem or account entry; a real Host with SFTP disabled is not available here.

paths.name: local-tier3-typed-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealTierThreeFallbackCapturesTypedInput (zsh 5.9.2 on darwin/arm64; zsh 5.9 on Linux Docker arm64/amd64): the unhooked shell's own prompt finishes a typed command at Tier 3 with no cwd or exit.

paths.name: powershell-local-hook
paths.evidence: TestRealPowerShellLocalHookCapturesTierOne (pwsh 7.6.9 on darwin/arm64) proves the hook, the single profile load, the private sequence, cwd, and exit. Windows cells remain manual and must run on a Windows runner; a macOS pwsh run is not Windows fidelity.

paths.name: powershell-local-tier3-fallback
paths.evidence: TestRealPowerShellTierThreeFallback (pwsh 7.6.9 on darwin/arm64): typed input plus the profile's own prompt finishes a Tier 3 row with no cwd or exit. Windows cells are manual.

paths.name: local-tier3-typed-fallback-bash

Turn the capture hook back on before the next cell.

Install the shell: bash ships with Git for Windows; install zsh/fish from MSYS2 (winget install MSYS2.MSYS2; pacman -S --needed zsh fish).
Record the shell --version and put its directory, or the MSYS2 usr/bin, on PATH (set NETCATTY_TEST_FISH for fish when it is not on PATH).
Open Settings > Logs in Netcatty, turn off "History capture hook", then open a local session that starts fish with `-l`.
Type `echo netcatty_tier3_matrix`, press Enter, and require a Command History row with the typed command, no cwd, no exit code, and a measured duration (Tier 3).
Turn the capture hook back on before the next cell.

cells.evidence: Not observed here. Best-effort, non-blocking: an explicit POSIX shell on Windows keeps its POSIX startup and has no Netcatty hook; typed input plus prompt detection is Tier 3.

cells.name: linux-amd64-powershell

manual.runner: Linux amd64 Docker container golang:1.27-bookworm (sha256:dc0963f32053e4bc451d24d87e3892d42d01021b61f093e98eb95c0352bb84b0) with PowerShell 7.6.9
steps: Start the pinned image: docker run --platform linux/amd64 --rm -it -v "$PWD":/work -w /work golang:1.27-bookworm@sha256:dc0963f32053e4bc451d24d87e3892d42d01021b61f093e98eb95c0352bb84b0 bash
Install PowerShell 7.6.9 from the official linux-amd64 tar.gz into /opt/microsoft/powershell/7; record pwsh --version.
go test ./adapters/shellhook -run '^TestRealPowerShellLocalHookCapturesTierOne$' -count=1 -v
Require PASS with a Tier 1 row carrying the typed command, cwd, exit code, and exactly one profile load.
Record the image digest, pwsh version, and result in the release acceptance log.

cells.evidence: Not observed here. Release-blocking Linux PowerShell acceptance step in Docker; pwsh is optional on Linux but the Tier 1 PowerShell hook is the same one observed on macOS arm64.

cells.name: bsd-amd64-zsh

manual.runner: FreeBSD 14.2-RELEASE amd64 VM (bhyve, UTM, or QEMU)
steps: Record uname -a, freebsd-version -ku, and the downloaded image/checksum in the release log.
pkg install -y go zsh bash fish; install nushell 0.116.1 and xonsh 0.24.2 from pkg or the upstream release and record their versions.

go test ./adapters/shellhook -run '^(TestRealShellSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd|TestRealNushellSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd|TestRealXonshSessionCapturesTierOneEndToEnd|TestRealTierThreeFallbackCapturesTypedInput)$' -count=1 -v
Set NETCATTY_TEST_FISH, NETCATTY_TEST_NU, or NETCATTY_TEST_XONSH when the shell is not on PATH.
Require PASS and record the exact shell versions; the Tier 3 fallback must report no cwd and no exit.

cells.evidence: Not observed here. FreeBSD VM acceptance step; the POSIX startup files are shared with the observed macOS and Linux paths. Release-blocking.
